user.title: Add an upload source
user.description: Direct LAN uploads only. Nabu Casa and forwarded requests are rejected. Use a different random 64-character hexadecimal key for each source. Only its digest is saved.

error.invalid_source: Use 1–32 lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter.
error.invalid_network: Enter a private IPv4 or ULA IPv6 network in strict CIDR notation.
error.invalid_key: Enter a randomly generated key: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
error.duplicate_key: Use a different key for each source.
